name: side plank hip adduction
description: A Copenhagen-style side plank: support the upper leg on a bench and lift the lower leg toward it, training hip adduction and the core.
instructions: Lie on your side and place your upper leg on a stable bench, with your forearm on the floor beneath your shoulder.
Brace your trunk and lift your hips to form a straight line through your body.
Raise the lower leg toward the supported upper leg, squeezing the inner thigh.
Lower the bottom leg with control, complete your reps, and switch sides.
